data.narrative:
Strata Robotics is a Seed-stage robotics and manufacturing company founded by Eric Zhou and Alex Mason, which has raised $5.2M to date. The valuation landscape includes 9 private peers and 1 public comparable (ticker 277810.KQ), though the private peer set—including Walden Robotics, Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, and Generalist AI—lacks sufficient homogeneity at Strata's stage to support peer-median methodology.

The Stage-Progression method is applicable and forms the sole triangulation basis. Using the $5.2M raised as a valuation proxy and applying a typical 2.5x multiplier for progression from Seed to the next stage yields an implied valuation of $13M. This method assumes comparable risk and market conditions across the cohort transitioning through this stage boundary.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $11M (low) to $15M (high), with a median of $13M. The relatively narrow range reflects reliance on a single methodological input rather than corroborating approaches. Key uncertainties include whether the 2.5x step-up multiplier appropriately reflects sector-specific risk (robotics capital intensity and longer development cycles), the timing and structure of the next funding round, and the strength of Strata's technology differentiation relative to the identified peer universe. A peer-median cross-check becomes viable once additional Seed-stage or Series A comparables with disclosed valuations emerge.
